label: glm53-flash-exl3-1m

model.quantization: exl3-4bit routed experts; q4 dense; fp8 KV

container.name: tensorfold-glm53-flash-exl3-1m
container.gpus: all 4 NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3; one rank per GPU

platform_notes: The published recipe image is linux/arm64; this host runs a locally built linux/amd64 image from the same TensorFold v0.6.0 + patches.
start.sh targets 2-3 DGX Sparks over SSH/RoCE; this host runs one container with four ranks, one GPU each, all GPUs visible for NCCL/NVLink.
The NGC image sets NCCL_NET_PLUGIN=spcx (Spectrum-X); this non-RDMA host requires NCCL_NET_PLUGIN=none and NCCL_GIN_ENABLE=0.
TensorFold's GLM engine hardcodes cuda:0; the container entrypoint patches it to honor TF_GLM_DEVICE per rank.
qualification: Interface smoke (chat, reasoning, tool call, vision) passed. Capacity/decode/retrieval screens are recorded in docs/GLM53_RESULTS.md. Not a sustained-load or production-tail qualification.
secrets: Environment and credentials deliberately omitted; retain privately outside the repository
